name: wordsmith
description: Review contracts against your playbooks, research case law and legislation, draft from your blueprints and file documents into your Wordsmith repositories.

interface.longDescription:
Wordsmith is the legal AI platform for in-house legal teams. Connect your Wordsmith account to work with your organisation's legal knowledge without leaving ChatGPT.

- Review contracts against your team's playbooks and get findings with suggested redlines.
- Ask legal questions answered from your organisation's agents, policies and documents.
- Research case law and legislation in public legal databases.
- Compare, redline, translate and redact documents.
- Draft new documents from your team's blueprints.
- File documents into Wordsmith repositories, create and track legal tasks, and check your usage and time saved.
- See reviews, reports, repositories and tasks as interactive views: pick the changes you want and make the redline, read a report grid with its sources, and move tasks along on a board.

Wordsmith only reads and changes what your Wordsmith account can already access, and you approve the scopes when you connect. You need a Wordsmith account. Your administrator chooses which AI apps your organisation's members can connect, and you can disconnect ChatGPT at any time from Wordsmith's Connected apps settings.
defaultPrompt: Review this NDA against our NDA playbook and list the top risks.
Find recent UK case law on limitation of liability clauses.
How much time has Wordsmith saved me this month?

positive.description: List the agents the user can use
positive.prompt: List the Wordsmith agents I can use, with one line on what each does.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_resources with kind "agent" and returns each agent with a one-line description and a link to it in Wordsmith.

positive.prompt: How much have I used Wordsmith this month? Summary only.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_usage with a summary view for the current user and reports sessions, interactions and time saved for the month, compared with last month.

positive.description: Find playbooks for a contract type
positive.prompt: Which Wordsmith playbooks do I have for reviewing NDAs?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_resources with kind "playbook" and an NDA query, and lists the matching playbooks with links to Wordsmith.

positive.description: Review an attached NDA against a playbook
positive.prompt: Review the attached NDA against our NDA playbook. I act for the recipient.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the attached file to Wordsmith, finds the NDA playbook, starts a playbook review for the recipient, waits for it, and summarises the findings as major, minor and info issues with a link to the review in Wordsmith.

positive.prompt: Find UK case law on implied terms in commercial contracts from the last five years.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls legal_research for the UK and returns relevant cases from the last five years with citations and links to their public sources.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my Wordsmith repositories.
Review this contract against my playbook.
What's a good recipe for banana bread?

publication.release_notes: Reviews name severities in Wordsmith's words (major, minor, info), and the review view finishes a running review itself, with compact rows, passed checks and their reasoning. Drafts and transformed documents come back as files you can download. Repository reports show one status line while they fill. Reviews route to your saved playbook when you name one.
